text:
Ava Chen: Quick check on the autoscale panel mocks. Key items: SLO slider default, min/max affordance, burst labeling, and fallback messaging.
Liam Patel: The SLO slider default currently skews to high min values. Recommend soft default 70% not 92%. Also show immediate cost delta when sliding.
Sofi Gomez: A11y: pool picker traps focus and duplicates headings on VoiceOver. Make it a dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) and restore focus to trigger on close. Add aria-describedby to helper copy.
Marco Rivera: Users read "burst" as permanent. Propose label: "Burst (temporary)" + helper: "Short-term extra GPUs; billed separately".
Ellie Tran: Fallback toast needs to explain routing and perf/privacy: current "Fallback active" is too vague. Draft: "Fallback active: selected pool at capacity. Routing to Redwood Hosted for availability. Data remains encrypted; reserve Dedicated capacity to prevent routing. (Details)"
Ava Chen: UX idea: if min=0 & burst on, show a tiny sparkline under min/max illustrating cold-start tail latency.
Liam Patel: Will mock cost delta and sparkline. Keep cost text subtle (small grey).
Sofi Gomez: Slider should expose aria-valuetext like "Reliability 70 percent; increasing reliability may raise cost." Ensure condensed labels have visually-hidden text for screen readers.
Marco Rivera: I'll send two microcopy variants for burst & slider hint by EOD.
Ellie Tran: Deploy-bot: autoscale-ui-v2 landed staging 2024-11-06T16:22Z. Please validate keyboard + VO flows before promote.
Ava Chen: Thanks team — I'll update Figma and drop the link here when ready. :raised_hands:
